“Bifocal diffusion R2LM throughput” is directly addressed by the paper introducing Bifocal dLLMs and its R2LM instantiation (Right-to-Left Mamba). The paper explains that R2LM uses causal attention for left-context with full KV-cache compatibility, plus a lightweight reverse Mamba sidecar to supply compressed right-side context, resolving the bidirectional-attention vs KV-caching throughput dilemma [1].

In terms of throughput, the paper reports that R2LM achieves 2.4× to 12.9× higher throughput than bidirectional dLLMs, and 1.9× to 2.9× speedups over autoregressive baselines in batch serving via parallel decoding with KV caching [1].
